summary: Stellantis Finance US Inc., a wholly owned indirect subsidiary of Stellantis N.V., filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for two series of senior fixed rate notes with maturities in the 20s, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Stellantis N.V. Terms including principal amount, coupon, pricing and maturity dates were left blank in the preliminary filing. The notes are unsecured and unsubordinated, ranking equally with existing unsecured debt, issued in denominations of $2,000 and $1,000 increments, with optional and tax-event redemption plus a change-of-control put. Underwriters include Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs and others. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing and demand.
